account.unsavedSignOut: There are unsaved changes. Sign out anyway?

publish.savedNotice: Draft saved. The preview will catch up in a minute or two.
publish.publishedNotice: Publishing revision {{revision}}. The live site updates in a minute or two.
publish.saveFirst: Save the newest edits before previewing or publishing.
publish.noDeployHook: This revision is published, but no deploy hook is configured — nothing is rebuilding the live site. Set DEPLOY_HOOK_URL on the Worker.

signin.intro: Sign in to edit the site.
signin.failed: The sign-in could not be completed.

common.imageDescription: Description, for anyone who cannot see it
common.imageHint: Say what is in the photograph, not that it is a photograph.

dashboard.title: Control panel
dashboard.intro: The state of the site and the way into every part of it. Save keeps the draft, preview lets you review it, and publish makes it public.
dashboard.savingBuildsPreview: Saving writes the draft and rebuilds the preview.
dashboard.nothingPublished: Nothing has been published from this admin.
dashboard.projectsNote: The grid at the end of the about page.
dashboard.photoNote: In the draft, across the works, the people and the front page.
dashboard.bilingualNote: Both languages, always. A blank in either blocks the save.
dashboard.contactNote: Address, hours, and how people reach you.
dashboard.connectorsNote: Read-only endpoints serving the published revision. No writes, no drafts.
dashboard.apiNote: Compiled from the connectors themselves. Hand it to whoever builds the site.
dashboard.historyNote: Every revision that was ever live, and the way back to one.
dashboard.stateFailed: The site’s state could not be read.

pageText.titleHint: The heading at the top of the page, the browser tab, and the word in the menu — all three, so they cannot disagree.
pageText.descriptionHint: One or two sentences. It appears under the link in a search result, which is why this is the one prose box with no formatting on it — a search result carries none.

homePage.intro: The first thing anyone sees: one line, and the photographs under it.
homePage.titleHint: Not shown on the page — the statement below is its heading. This is what the browser tab and a shared link say.
homePage.statementHint: One line. It holds the whole first screen on its own, and it is the page’s heading. Line breaks are kept: press return where you want the line to break.
homePage.galleryHint: They run full width, one at a time, below the fold, in this order.
homePage.empty: No photographs yet — the front page is the statement on its own.

worksPage.intro: Every work on the site, in the order a visitor meets them. Move a row to change that order; open one to edit it.

programsPage.intro: Every programme, in the order a reader scrolls through them. Open one to edit it.
programsPage.keyHint: Not shown to anyone. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

aboutPage.intro: What the studio says about itself, then the people, then the projects — in that order down the page.
aboutPage.introHint: The paragraphs at the top of the page.
aboutPage.mentorsHint: The heading over the band of portraits. {{count}} person is in it.
aboutPage.mentorsHint_other: The heading over the band of portraits. {{count}} people are in it.
aboutPage.projectsHint: The heading over the grid of projects. {{count}} project is under it.
aboutPage.projectsHint_other: The heading over the grid of projects. {{count}} projects are under it.

mentorPage.intro: The people, as a band of portraits a third of the way down the about page, read in this order.
mentorPage.keyHint: Not shown to anyone, but it names the portrait file.
mentorPage.oneLineHint: Exactly one sentence. The layout gives it one line.
mentorPage.needsKey: Give this person a key first — it names the portrait file.
mentorPage.removeQuestion: Remove {{name}} from the site? Their portrait stays in storage.

projectsPage.intro: The grid at the end of the about page: a picture, a name and a line or two each, read in this order. These are not the works — a project is its own record, and adding one here changes nothing on the works index.
projectsPage.empty: No projects yet. Until there is one, the about page ends on the people and the section is left out altogether.
projectsPage.keyHint: Not shown to anyone, and not a web address — a project has no page. It names the picture file.
projectsPage.summaryHint: A line or two under the picture. The card has room for a sentence, not a paragraph.
projectsPage.needsKey: Give this project a key first — it names the picture file.
projectsPage.removeQuestion: Remove {{name}} from the about page? Its picture stays in storage.

contactPage.linesHint: The card keeps the lines you type. Press return where the address should break.
contactPage.intro: The card the Contact button pins over whichever page the reader is on. The details, and the words that label them.

photographs.title: Photograph sizes
photographs.intro: The site cannot resize a photograph on its way to a reader — image transformations are a paid setting on the domain, and this one does not have them. So every size a reader might be served is made here, in your browser, when the photograph is uploaded.
photographs.missing: {{count}} photograph is only stored full size.
photographs.missing_other: {{count}} photographs are only stored full size.
photographs.missingNote: They were uploaded before the smaller sizes were made. Until they have them, a phone is sent the full-size picture and may fail to show it at all.
photographs.doneNote: The pictures themselves are untouched — nothing is re-saved, so no address changes and nothing already published moves. Publish afterwards so the site starts using them.

generalPage.typeScaleHint: How large the site sets all of its text. Every size moves together, so headings, prose and labels keep their proportions. It only goes up: the smallest text on the site is already at the smallest size that stays readable.
generalPage.intro: What is left once every other word went to the page it appears on.
generalPage.studioNameHint: The logotype at the top of every page, and the name in the footer.
generalPage.missing: When a page cannot be found
generalPage.rarelyNote: The site reads these by name, so they cannot be left out — but nobody changes them twice in a decade.

fields.name: Name
fields.title: Title
fields.uploadFailed: That image could not be uploaded.

status.in-progress: In progress — has its own page
status.private: Private — listed, but not clickable and publishes no images

works.addressReady: The page will be at /zh/works/{{slug}}/. Changing this breaks any link already shared.
works.addressEmpty: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Set this before adding photographs—it decides where they are filed.
works.numberHint: The running number shown in the index.
works.photoHint: These images run down the right of the work page, in this order.
works.needsAddress: Give this work a web address first—it decides where its photographs are filed.
works.removeQuestion: Remove {{title}} from the site? Its photographs stay in storage, so a developer can restore them.

historyPage.intro: Each publish appends a revision. Restoring one publishes its content again as a new revision, so nothing that was ever live is lost.
historyPage.question: Publish revision {{revision}} again? It becomes the newest revision and the live site rebuilds.
historyPage.dirtyWarning: You have unsaved edits. They stay in the draft and will be behind the live site until you save and publish again.
historyPage.readFailed: The history could not be read.
historyPage.restored: Revision {{from}} is being published again as revision {{to}}. The live site updates in a minute or two.

devPage.intro: The read-only API as a frontend sees it. This document is generated from the connectors, so it always matches what the Worker answers.
devPage.notProbed: Not tried from here — sending one would put a real message in the studio’s inbox.
devPage.documentFailed: The API document could not be read.
devPage.truncated: … {{characters}} more characters. Open {{path}} in a tab for the whole of it.

problems.title: {{count}} thing to fix before this can be saved
problems.title_other: {{count}} things to fix before this can be saved

message.slugChars: may only use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens
message.notAStatus: is not one of the three states
message.duplicateWork: is used by more than one work ("{{slug}}")
message.duplicateProgram: is used by more than one programme ("{{slug}}")
message.duplicateMentor: is used by more than one person ("{{slug}}")
message.duplicateProject: is used by more than one project ("{{slug}}")
message.notInStorage: names a photograph that is not in storage ({{file}}) — upload it again, or remove the image
